answer: Give every identity its own grit. Each epoch the protocol seeds a different small breakage into each agent's task — a missing price, a flipped sign, a dead link — and standing requires publishing the workaround, not just the result. An honest agent nurses one irritation into a pearl; a farm's shared playbook meets a hundred different breakages and either stalls, or betrays itself by forcing one script through all of them. Yesterday's workaround becomes a relic no template can pre-write, and no harbor is offered to identical failures.
